question: For $A=\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\3&4\end{bmatrix}$, find the minors of all its elements and arrange them in a matrix.
explanation:
Minors of the first row
Deleting the first row and first column leaves the element $4$. Hence, $M_{11}=4$. Deleting the first row and second column leaves $3$. Hence, $M_{12}=3$.
Minors of the second row
Deleting the second row and first column leaves $-1$. Therefore, $M_{21}=-1$. Deleting the second row and second column leaves $2$. Therefore, $M_{22}=2$.
Arrangement of the minors
Placing each minor in its corresponding position gives $$\begin{bmatrix}M_{11}&M_{12}\\M_{21}&M_{22}\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}4&3\\-1&2\end{bmatrix}$$
Hence, the required matrix of minors is $\begin{bmatrix}4&3\\-1&2\end{bmatrix}$.
